# Net Power Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 28, 2026 4:15pm EDT


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Net Power Inc. (NYSE: NPWR) plans to report its third quarter 2026 financial results and provide a business update after market close on Thursday, November 12, 2026, and will host a conference call on Friday, November 13, 2026 beginning at 8:30 AM ET.


To access the live audio webcast of the conference call, please visit Net Power’s investor relations website at[ir.netpower.com](https://ir.netpower.com/) . To participate by phone, dial 877-407-8014 (domestic) or +1 201-689-8053 (international).


An archived webcast will be available following the call.


**About Net Power**


Net Power Inc. (NYSE: NPWR) (“Net Power” or the “Company”) is an energy technology and project development company. The Company’s near-term development activities are focused on delivering natural gas power generation to meet growing demand for reliable power.
